I absolutely love making this in the summer because I find it the perfect combination of light and healthy! It's also very cheap and very easy to make and it makes a perfect side dish if you're eating something spicy/chilli!

Ingredient list:

  • Half an English Cucumber
  • Sour cream (alternatively you can use Greek yoghurt)
  • Handful of chives
  • Handful of dill
  • Salt to season
  • Pepper to season

Method:

  1. Using a grater, grate your cucumber half into a strainer. Once fully grated, ensure that the majority of the water from the cucumber is drained, otherwise you end up with a very watery salad.
  2. Once drained, put the grated cucumber into a medium sized bowl. Then, finely chop the chives and the dill and add into the bowl with the cucumber.
  3. Add around 2 heaped tablespoons of sour cream (or your alternative) and mix everything together.
  4. Season to taste.
  5. Serve!

Variations of this recipe also include using minced garlic cloves, the use of olive oil, vinegar, lemon juice and everything else that people have tried and tested. I personally think that the recipe is absolutely fine on its own and tastes just as good though!

I find that it's also used pretty well as a dip and a refreshingly healthy smoothie combination. :)
